narrative.overview: Conecta Nexus marries the institutional authority of Universidad Francisco de Paula Santander with a fresh, tactile, Meeko-inspired neo-brutalist aesthetic. It breaks cleanly away from sterile, bureaucratic academic administration systems, presenting an energetic, high-contrast digital campus that feels as dynamic as a modern venture lab or creative studio.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Neo-Brutalism: Solid 2px ink borders with flat, unapologetic hard-drop shadows (3px to 6px offsets with zero blur radius).
Institutional Anchor: Official UFPS Crimson Red (#bc0017) as the single high-potency accent on brand marks, primary actions, and critical state indicators.
Harmonious Pastel Accents: Soft coral, ice blue, mint, and peach surfaces that soften industrial lines and delineate roles.
Uncompromising Legibility: Bold geometry powered by self-hosted Uncut Sans across display headings, interactive tabs, form controls, and body copy.

rules.name: The 10% Crimson Rule
rules.body: Institutional Red (#bc0017) is an intentional lightning rod. It covers ≤10% of any viewport so that primary calls-to-action and institutional badges remain unmistakable.

rules.name: The Role Chromatic Anchor Rule
rules.body: Estudiantes UFPS always associate with Ice Blue (#e8effd); Empresas / PYMEs always associate with Pastel Coral (#f3c5ba). This chromatic distinction must remain invariant across authentication, dashboard views, and challenge applications.

rules.name: The Hard-Case Rule
rules.body: Form labels, role badges, and primary action triggers use bold uppercase text with positive tracking (letter-spacing: 0.05em) to eliminate ambiguity.

rules.name: The Zero-Blur Doctrine
rules.body: Drop shadows have 0px blur radius at all times. Depth is conveyed exclusively through crisp offset geometry.

dos: Do use exact 2px dark ink borders (#191c21 or #262626) on all cards, inputs, and interactive surfaces.
Do keep drop shadows solid with 0px blur (box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px rgba(0,0,0,1)).
Do maintain the 50/50 split on desktop authentication pages to preserve visual balance.
Do enforce institutional student domain validation (@ufps.edu.co) and corporate NIT formats.
Do keep all end-user UI copy strictly in Spanish while preserving English in code symbols.
donts: Don't use faint pastel gradients or blurry shadows (box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(...)) that dilute the neo-brutalist character.
Don't use generic stock photos or corporate 'handshake' clipart; rely on technical doodles, authentic stickers, and bold typography.
Don't use UFPS Crimson Red (#bc0017) as full-page background washes; its rarity preserves its potency.
Don't bypass Colombian Habeas Data (Ley 1581) consent dialogs on student or company registration flows.
